purpose: Non-transcribable owner-oracle layer. inputs/phases/02-route-decision.md spells out the required per-lane routing decisions as literal bullet text (finding-18: these bullets appear verbatim in routeDecisionMarkers, so a memorized/copied answer that reproduces the ORIGINAL bullet wording passes even when it never actually re-reads the current phase file). The active perturbation is detected by hashing that phase file; a candidate that transcribes a cached/prior-session answer instead of reading the CURRENT phase-file bullets must fail.

selector.detection: sha256 of inputs/phases/02-route-decision.md's current bytes must match exactly one perturbation entry's input_snapshots map; no match is a hard verifier error (unrecognized/drifted inputs state).

perturbations.description: Unperturbed reference packet: the phase file committed in this bundle (systems/toolchain single-shot: X3 primary; UI implementation single-shot: X3 primary, X5 contender only).

The phase file's 'systems/toolchain single-shot' bullet is rewritten to 'X1 primary, staged N39 pending' (was X3 primary). The route decision must mirror the CURRENT phase-file bullet, not the baseline value.

add_routeDecisionMarkers: systems/toolchain single-shot: X1 primary, staged N39 pending
remove_routeDecisionMarkers: systems/toolchain single-shot: X3 primary, staged N39 pending

perturbations.description: The phase file's 'UI implementation single-shot' bullet is rewritten to 'X5 primary, staged N38 pending, X3 contender only' (was X3 primary, X5 contender only). The route decision must mirror the CURRENT phase-file bullet, not the baseline value.

add_routeDecisionMarkers: UI implementation single-shot: X5 primary, staged N38 pending, X3 contender only
remove_routeDecisionMarkers: UI implementation single-shot: X3 primary, staged N38 pending, X5 contender only
